title: Vibrant Enchanted Books
description: Add dynamic textures for every enchanted books!
body:
## **Installation Instructions**  
Place the resourcepack in `resourcepacks` folders.

## **Overview**  
* **Feature:** Adds 16x animated textures to all vanilla enchanted books.
* **Extended Support:** Fully supports enchanted books from the *Dungeons and Taverns* datapack.
* **Compatibility:** **Incompatible** with any other enchanted book texture packs.
